description: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.
longDescription: This Pokemon's moves that match one of its types have a same-type attack bonus (STAB) of 2 instead of 1.5.
name: Adaptability
shortDescription: This Pokemon's same-type attack bonus (STAB) is 2 instead of 1.5.

description: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
name: Aerilate
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Flying type and have 1.2× power.

description: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a contact move, that move's user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down. This effect is prevented if the move's user has the Magic Guard Ability or if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
name: Aftermath
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is KOed with a contact move, that move's user loses 1/4 its max HP.

description: Eliminates the effects of weather.
name: Air Lock
shortDescription: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.
longDescription: The power of this Pokemon's move is multiplied by 1.3 if it is the last to move in a turn. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight.
name: Analytic
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks have 1.3× power if it is the last to move in a turn.

description: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.
longDescription: If this Pokemon, but not its substitute, is struck by a critical hit, its Attack is raised by 12 stages.
name: Anger Point
shortDescription: If this Pokemon (not its substitute) takes a critical hit, its Attack is raised 12 stages.

description: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
longDescription: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are raised by 1 stage, and its Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
name: Anger Shell
shortDescription: At 1/2 or less of this Pokemon's max HP: +1 Atk, Sp. Atk, Spe, and -1 Def, Sp. Def.

description: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.
longDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted if any opposing Pokemon has an attacking move with a type that is super effective against this Pokemon, or any OHKO move. This effect considers Hidden Power to be its determined type, and every other move to be its original type.
name: Anticipation
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon shudders if any foe has a supereffective or OHKO move.

description: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing from battle.
longDescription: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne, are holding a Shed Shell, or are a Ghost type.
name: Arena Trap
shortDescription: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne.

description: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
longDescription: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
name: Armor Tail
shortDescription: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.

description: Protects the Pokémon and its allies from effects that prevent the use of moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon and its allies cannot become affected by Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, or Torment.
name: Aroma Veil
shortDescription: Protects user/allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.

name: As One (Glastrier)
shortDescription: Combination of the Unnerve and Chilling Neigh Abilities.

name: As One (Spectrier)
shortDescription: Combination of the Unnerve and Grim Neigh Abilities.

description: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.
longDescription: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura Abilities are reversed, multiplying the power of Dark- and Fairy-type moves, respectively, by 3/4 instead of 1.33.
name: Aura Break
shortDescription: While this Pokemon is active, the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura power modifier is 0.75×.

description: Damages opposing Pokémon that are asleep.
longDescription: Causes opposing Pokemon to lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn if they are asleep.
name: Bad Dreams
shortDescription: Causes sleeping foes to lose 1/8 of their max HP at the end of each turn.

description: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
name: Ball Fetch
shortDescription: No competitive use.

description: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.
name: Battery
shortDescription: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their special attacks multiplied by 1.3.

description: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
name: Battle Armor
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, its bond with its Trainer is strengthened, and its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Greninja, its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. This effect can only happen once per battle.
name: Battle Bond
shortDescription: After KOing a Pokemon: raises Attack, Sp. Atk, Speed by 1 stage. Once per battle.

description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
name: Beads of Ruin
shortDescription: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Defense multiplied by 0.75.

description: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.
longDescription: This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. Stat stage changes are not considered. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order.
name: Beast Boost
shortDescription: This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to drop to half or less.
longDescription: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Special Attack is raised by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
name: Berserk
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 when it reaches 1/2 or less of its max HP.

description: Prevents the Pokémon from having its Defense stat lowered.
name: Big Pecks
shortDescription: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Defense stat stage.

description: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
longDescription: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.
name: Blaze
shortDescription: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5× with Fire attacks.

description: Protects the Pokémon from ball and bomb moves.
name: Bulletproof
shortDescription: This Pokemon is immune to bullet moves.

description: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.
longDescription: If this Pokemon eats a held Berry, it restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, in addition to the Berry's effect. This effect can also activate after the effects of Bug Bite, Fling, Pluck, Stuff Cheeks, and Teatime if the eaten Berry had an effect on this Pokemon.
name: Cheek Pouch
shortDescription: If this Pokemon eats a Berry, it restores 1/3 of its max HP after the Berry's effect.

description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.
name: Chilling Neigh
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.
longDescription: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
name: Chlorophyll
shortDescription: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

description: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.
name: Clear Body
shortDescription: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

description: Eliminates the effects of weather.
name: Cloud Nine
shortDescription: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

description: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.
longDescription: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the last move that hit it, unless that type is already one of its types. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
name: Color Change
shortDescription: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of a move it's hit by, unless it has the type.

description: The Pokémon is always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack while in its sleeping state.
longDescription: This Pokemon is considered to be asleep and cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn.
name: Comatose
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be statused, and is considered to be asleep.

description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Tatsugiri and a Dondozo is an active ally, this Pokemon goes into the Dondozo's mouth. The Dondozo has its Attack, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, and Special Defense raised by 2 stages. During the effect, the Dondozo cannot be switched out, this Pokemon cannot select an action, and attacks targeted at this Pokemon will be avoided but it will still take indirect damage. If this Pokemon faints during the effect, a Pokemon can be switched in as a replacement but the Dondozo remains unable to be switched out. If the Dondozo faints during the effect, this Pokemon regains the ability to select an action.
name: Commander
shortDescription: If ally is Dondozo: this Pokemon cannot act or be hit, +2 to all Dondozo's stats.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.
name: Competitive
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 2 for each of its stats that is lowered by a foe.

description: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.
name: Compound Eyes
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.

description: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them—and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.
name: Contrary
shortDescription: If this Pokemon has a stat stage raised it is lowered instead, and vice versa.

description: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.
name: Corrosion
shortDescription: This Pokemon can poison or badly poison a Pokemon regardless of its typing.

description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.
name: Costar
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies all of its ally's stat stage changes.

description: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.
longDescription: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field is lowered by 1 stage.
name: Cotton Down
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is hit, it lowers the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field 1 stage.

description: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
name: Cud Chew
shortDescription: If this Pokemon eats a Berry, it will eat that Berry again at the end of the next turn.

description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.
name: Curious Medicine
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon's allies have their stat stages reset to 0.

description: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, there is a 30% chance that move gets disabled unless one of the attacker's moves is already disabled.
name: Cursed Body
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, there is a 30% chance that move gets disabled.

description: The Pokémon may infatuate attackers that make direct contact with it.
longDescription: There is a 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will become infatuated if it is of the opposite gender.
name: Cute Charm
shortDescription: 30% chance of infatuating Pokemon of the opposite gender if they make contact.

description: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.
longDescription: While this Pokemon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.
name: Damp
shortDescription: Prevents Explosion/Mind Blown/Misty Explosion/Self-Destruct/Aftermath while active.

description: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.
longDescription: After another Pokemon uses a dance move, this Pokemon uses the same move. The copied move is subject to all effects that can prevent a move from being executed. A move used through this Ability cannot be copied again by other Pokemon with this Ability.
name: Dancer
shortDescription: After another Pokemon uses a dance move, this Pokemon uses the same move.

description: Powers up each Pokémon’s Dark-type moves.
longDescription: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Dark-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.
name: Dark Aura
shortDescription: While this Pokemon is active, a Dark move used by any Pokemon has 1.33× power.

description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
name: Dauntless Shield
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.

description: The Pokémon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
longDescription: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
name: Dazzling
shortDescription: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.

description: Halves the Pokémon’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.
longDescription: While this Pokemon has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Attack and Special Attack are halved.
name: Defeatist
shortDescription: While this Pokemon has 1/2 or less of its max HP, its Attack and Sp. Atk are halved.

description: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.
name: Defiant
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 for each of its stats that is lowered by a foe.

description: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type’s weaknesses.
longDescription: On switch-in, the weather becomes Strong Winds, which removes the weaknesses of the Flying type from Flying-type Pokemon. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Desolate Land or Primordial Sea Abilities.
name: Delta Stream
shortDescription: On switch-in, strong winds begin until this Ability is not active in battle.

description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.
longDescription: On switch-in, the weather becomes Intense Sun, which includes all the effects of Sun and prevents damaging Water-type moves from executing. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Delta Stream or Primordial Sea Abilities.
name: Desolate Land
shortDescription: On switch-in, extremely harsh sunlight begins until this Ability is not active in battle.

description: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Mimikyu, the first hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its disguise is then broken, it changes to Busted Form, and it loses 1/8 of its max HP. Confusion damage also breaks the disguise.
name: Disguise
shortDescription: (Mimikyu only) The first hit it takes is blocked, and it takes 1/8 HP damage instead.

description: The Pokémon compares an opposing Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.
longDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack or Special Attack is raised by 1 stage based on the weaker combined defensive stat of all opposing Pokemon. Attack is raised if their Defense is lower, and Special Attack is raised if their Special Defense is the same or lower.
name: Download
shortDescription: On switch-in, Attack or Sp. Atk is raised 1 stage based on the foes' weaker Defense.

description: Powers up Dragon-type moves.
name: Dragon's Maw
shortDescription: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dragon-type attack.

description: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.
name: Drizzle
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain.

description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.
name: Drought
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sun.

description: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move. The power of Fire-type moves is multiplied by 1.25 when used on this Pokemon. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Rain, and loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Sun. The weather effects are prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
name: Dry Skin
shortDescription: This Pokemon is healed 1/4 by Water, 1/8 by Rain; is hurt 1.25× by Fire, 1/8 by Sun.

description: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.
name: Early Bird
shortDescription: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.

description: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Ground-type move.
name: Earth Eater
shortDescription: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Ground moves; Ground immunity.

description: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on the attacker.
longDescription: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned, paralyzed, or fall asleep.
name: Effect Spore
shortDescription: 30% chance of poison/paralysis/sleep on others making contact with this Pokemon.

description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
name: Electric Surge
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Electric Terrain.

description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
name: Electromorphosis
shortDescription: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.

name: Embody Aspect (Cornerstone)
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage.

name: Embody Aspect (Hearthflame)
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage.

name: Embody Aspect (Teal)
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage.

name: Embody Aspect (Wellspring)
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Special Defense is raised by 1 stage.

description: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
longDescription: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.
name: Emergency Exit
shortDescription: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.

description: Powers up each Pokémon’s Fairy-type moves.
longDescription: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Fairy-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.
name: Fairy Aura
shortDescription: While this Pokemon is active, a Fairy move used by any Pokemon has 1.33× power.

description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.
name: Filter
shortDescription: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

description: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
name: Flame Body
shortDescription: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be burned.

description: Powers up special moves when the Pokémon is burned.
longDescription: While this Pokemon is burned, the power of its special attacks is multiplied by 1.5.
name: Flare Boost
shortDescription: While this Pokemon is burned, its special attacks have 1.5× power.

description: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time it is hit by a Fire-type move, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack as long as it remains active and has this Ability. If this Pokemon is frozen, it cannot be defrosted by Fire-type attacks.
name: Flash Fire
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Fire attacks do 1.5× damage if hit by one Fire move; Fire immunity.

description: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies in harsh sunlight.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Cherrim and Sun is active, it changes to Sunshine Form and the Attack and Special Defense of it and its allies are multiplied by 1.5. These effects are prevented if the Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
name: Flower Gift
shortDescription: If user is Cherrim and Sun is active, it and allies' Attack and Sp. Def are 1.5×.

description: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.
longDescription: Grass-type Pokemon on this Pokemon's side cannot have their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon or have a non-volatile status condition inflicted on them by other Pokemon.
name: Flower Veil
shortDescription: This side's Grass types can't have stats lowered or status inflicted by other Pokemon.

description: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from contact moves, but double damage from Fire moves.
name: Fluffy
shortDescription: This Pokemon takes 1/2 damage from contact moves, 2× damage from Fire moves.

description: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Castform, its type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella and the weather is Rain or Sun.
name: Forecast
shortDescription: Castform's type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm.

description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.
longDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted to the move with the highest power, at random, known by an opposing Pokemon. This effect considers OHKO moves to have 150 power, Counter, Mirror Coat, and Metal Burst to have 120 power, every other attacking move with an unspecified power to have 80 power, and non-damaging moves to have 1 power.
name: Forewarn
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted to the foes' move with the highest power.

description: Reduces damage dealt to allies.
name: Friend Guard
shortDescription: This Pokemon's allies receive 3/4 damage from other Pokemon's attacks.

description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.
name: Frisk
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.

description: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.
name: Full Metal Body
shortDescription: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

description: Halves the damage from physical moves.
name: Fur Coat
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Defense is doubled.

description: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.
name: Gale Wings
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Flying-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

description: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
name: Galvanize
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Electric type and have 1.2× power.

description: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.
longDescription: When this Pokemon is holding a Berry that usually activates with 1/4 or less of its maximum HP, it is eaten at 1/2 or less of its maximum HP instead.
name: Gluttony
shortDescription: This Pokemon eats Berries at 1/2 max HP or less instead of their usual 1/4 max HP.

description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.
name: Good as Gold
shortDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.

description: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
name: Gooey
shortDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.

description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5, but it can only select the first move it executes. These effects are prevented while this Pokemon is Dynamaxed.
name: Gorilla Tactics
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5×, but it can only select the first move it executes.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.
name: Grass Pelt
shortDescription: If Grassy Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
name: Grassy Surge
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.

description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.
name: Grim Neigh
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability and raises its Attack by 1 stage instead. This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.
name: Guard Dog
shortDescription: Immune to Intimidate. Intimidated: +1 Attack. Cannot be forced to switch out.

description: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Cramorant, it changes forme when it hits a target with Surf or uses the first turn of Dive successfully. It becomes Gulping Form with an Arrokuda in its mouth if it has more than 1/2 of its maximum HP remaining, or Gorging Form with a Pikachu in its mouth if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP remaining. If Cramorant gets hit in Gulping or Gorging Form, it spits the Arrokuda or Pikachu at its attacker, even if it has no HP remaining. The projectile deals damage equal to 1/4 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down; this damage is blocked by the Magic Guard Ability but not by a substitute. An Arrokuda also lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage, and a Pikachu paralyzes the target. Cramorant will return to normal if it spits out a projectile, switches out, or Dynamaxes.
name: Gulp Missile
shortDescription: When hit after Surf/Dive, attacker takes 1/4 max HP and -1 Defense or paralysis.

description: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.
longDescription: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Attack is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon's physical attacks ignore the burn effect of halving damage.
name: Guts
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is statused, its Attack is 1.5×; ignores burn halving physical damage.

description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
name: Hadron Engine
shortDescription: On switch-in, summons Electric Terrain. During Electric Terrain, Sp. Atk is 1.3333×.

description: May create another Berry after one is used.
longDescription: If the last item this Pokemon used is a Berry, there is a 50% chance it gets restored at the end of each turn. If Sun is active, this chance is 100%.
name: Harvest
shortDescription: If last item used is a Berry, 50% chance to restore it each end of turn. 100% in Sun.

description: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.
longDescription: 30% chance this Pokemon's ally has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.
name: Healer
shortDescription: 30% chance this Pokemon's ally has its status cured at the end of each turn.

description: The Pokémon's heatproof body halves the damage taken from Fire-type moves.
longDescription: If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon takes half of the usual burn damage, rounded down.
name: Heatproof
shortDescription: Fire damage against this Pokemon is dealt with 1/2 offensive stat; 1/2 burn damage.

description: Doubles the Pokémon's weight.
longDescription: This Pokemon's weight is doubled. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone.
name: Heavy Metal
shortDescription: This Pokemon's weight is doubled.

description: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.
name: Honey Gather
shortDescription: No competitive use.

description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP
name: Hospitality
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.

description: Doubles the Pokémon's Attack stat.
name: Huge Power
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.

description: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Morpeko, it changes formes between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.
name: Hunger Switch
shortDescription: If Morpeko, it changes between Full Belly and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and the accuracy of its physical attacks is multiplied by 0.8.
name: Hustle
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5× and accuracy of its physical attacks is 0.8×.

description: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.
longDescription: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn if Rain is active. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
name: Hydration
shortDescription: This Pokemon has its status cured at the end of each turn if Rain is active.

description: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.
name: Hyper Cutter
shortDescription: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.

description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.
longDescription: If Snow is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn.
name: Ice Body
shortDescription: If Snow is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.

description: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is an Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its ice face is then broken and it changes forme to Noice Face. Eiscue regains its Ice Face forme when Snow begins or when Eiscue switches in while Snow is active. Confusion damage also breaks the ice face.
name: Ice Face
shortDescription: If Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes deals 0 damage. Effect is restored in Snow.

description: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.
name: Ice Scales
shortDescription: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from special attacks.

description: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.
longDescription: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.
name: Illuminate
shortDescription: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.

description: The Pokémon fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its Trainer's party.
longDescription: When this Pokemon switches in, it appears as the last unfainted Pokemon in its party until it takes direct damage from another Pokemon's attack. This Pokemon's actual level and HP are displayed instead of those of the mimicked Pokemon.
name: Illusion
shortDescription: This Pokemon appears as the last Pokemon in the party until it takes direct damage.

description: The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.
name: Immunity
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

description: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.
longDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it. If there is no Pokemon at that position, this Pokemon does not Transform.
name: Imposter
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it.

description: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.
longDescription: This Pokemon's moves ignore substitutes and the opposing side's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.
name: Infiltrator
shortDescription: Moves ignore substitutes and foe's Reflect/Light Screen/Safeguard/Mist/Aurora Veil.

description: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a move, that move's user loses HP equal to the amount of damage inflicted on this Pokemon.
name: Innards Out
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is KOed with a move, that move's user loses an equal amount of HP.

description: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.
longDescription: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
name: Inner Focus
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. Immune to Intimidate.

description: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.
name: Insomnia
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.
longDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.
name: Intimidate
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opponents by 1 stage.

description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
name: Intrepid Sword
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.

description: Inflicts damage on the attacker upon contact with iron barbs.
longDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.
name: Iron Barbs
shortDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.

description: Powers up punching moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.2.
name: Iron Fist
shortDescription: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have 1.2× power. Sucker Punch is not boosted.

description: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.
name: Justified
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.

description: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.
longDescription: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.
name: Keen Eye
shortDescription: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.

description: The Pokémon can't use any held items.
longDescription: This Pokemon's held item has no effect. This Pokemon cannot use Fling successfully. Macho Brace, Power Anklet, Power Band, Power Belt, Power Bracer, Power Lens, and Power Weight still have their effects.
name: Klutz
shortDescription: This Pokemon's held item has no effect, except Macho Brace. Fling cannot be used.

description: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.
longDescription: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
name: Leaf Guard
shortDescription: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot be statused and Rest will fail for it.

description: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.
name: Levitate
shortDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.

description: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
longDescription: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.
name: Libero
shortDescription: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.

description: Halves the Pokémon's weight.
longDescription: This Pokemon's weight is halved, rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.
name: Light Metal
shortDescription: This Pokemon's weight is halved.

description: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.
name: Lightning Rod
shortDescription: This Pokemon draws Electric moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Electric immunity.

description: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.
name: Limber
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.

description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
longDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Lingering Aroma. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Lingering Aroma, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
name: Lingering Aroma
shortDescription: Making contact with this Pokemon has the attacker's Ability become Lingering Aroma.

description: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.
name: Liquid Ooze
shortDescription: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.

description: Sound-based moves become Water-type moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
name: Liquid Voice
shortDescription: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water type.

description: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
name: Long Reach
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.

description: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.
longDescription: This Pokemon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.
name: Magic Bounce
shortDescription: This Pokemon blocks certain Status moves and bounces them back to the user.

description: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.
longDescription: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.
name: Magic Guard
shortDescription: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks.

description: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.
longDescription: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.
name: Magician
shortDescription: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack.

description: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.
name: Magma Armor
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.

description: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.
longDescription: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell or are a Ghost type.
name: Magnet Pull
shortDescription: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out.

description: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.
name: Marvel Scale
shortDescription: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

description: Powers up pulse moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon's pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of a target's maximum HP, rounded half down.
name: Mega Launcher
shortDescription: This Pokemon's pulse moves have 1.5× power. Heal Pulse heals 3/4 target's max HP.

description: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
name: Merciless
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.

description: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.
longDescription: This Pokemon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokemon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokemon's types become the original types for its species.
name: Mimicry
shortDescription: This Pokemon's types change to match the Terrain. Type reverts when Terrain ends.

description: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves
longDescription: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.
name: Mind's Eye
shortDescription: Fighting, Normal moves hit Ghost. Accuracy can't be lowered, ignores evasiveness.

description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
longDescription: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.
name: Minus
shortDescription: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×.

description: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
longDescription: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.
name: Mirror Armor
shortDescription: If this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered, the attacker's are lowered instead.

description: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
name: Misty Surge
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Misty Terrain.

description: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
longDescription: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.
name: Mold Breaker
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

description: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.
longDescription: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.
name: Moody
shortDescription: Boosts a random stat (except accuracy/evasion) +2 and another stat -1 every turn.

description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.
name: Motor Drive
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by an Electric move; Electric immunity.

description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.
name: Moxie
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

description: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
name: Multiscale
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

description: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the plate it holds.
name: Multitype
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is an Arceus, its type changes to match its held Plate.

description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.
longDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
name: Mummy
shortDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy.

description: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Status moves ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon, and go last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.
name: Mycelium Might
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Status moves go last in their priority bracket and ignore Abilities.

description: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.
name: Natural Cure
shortDescription: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

description: Powers up moves that are super effective.
longDescription: This Pokemon's attacks that are super effective against the target have their damage multiplied by 1.25.
name: Neuroforce
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.25× damage.

description: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
longDescription: While this Pokemon is active, Abilities have no effect. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect. Does not affect the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
name: Neutralizing Gas
shortDescription: While this Pokemon is active, Abilities have no effect.

description: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.
name: No Guard
shortDescription: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

description: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
longDescription: This Pokemon's moves are changed to be Normal type and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes before other effects that change a move's type.
name: Normalize
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves are changed to be Normal type and have 1.2× power.

description: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.
longDescription: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
name: Oblivious
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Immune to Intimidate.

description: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
name: Opportunist
shortDescription: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
name: Orichalcum Pulse
shortDescription: On switch-in, summons Sun. During Sun, Attack is 1.3333×.

description: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.
name: Overcoat
shortDescription: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, Sandstorm damage, and Effect Spore.

description: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
longDescription: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.
name: Overgrow
shortDescription: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5× with Grass attacks.

description: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.
longDescription: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
name: Own Tempo
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Immune to Intimidate.

description: Parent and child each attacks.
longDescription: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.
name: Parental Bond
shortDescription: This Pokemon's damaging moves hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered.

description: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.
longDescription: This Pokemon and its allies cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while this Pokemon or its ally is poisoned cures them. If this Ability is being ignored during an effect that causes poison, this Pokemon is cured immediately but its ally is not.
name: Pastel Veil
shortDescription: This Pokemon and its allies cannot be poisoned. On switch-in, cures poisoned allies.

description: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
longDescription: Making contact with this Pokemon starts the Perish Song effect for it and the attacker. This effect does not happen for this Pokemon if the attacker already has a perish count.
name: Perish Body
shortDescription: Making contact with this Pokemon starts the Perish Song effect for it and the attacker.

description: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.
longDescription: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
name: Pickpocket
shortDescription: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item.

description: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
longDescription: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.
name: Pickup
shortDescription: If this Pokemon has no item, it finds one used by an adjacent Pokemon this turn.

description: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
name: Pixilate
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy type and have 1.2× power.

description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
longDescription: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.
name: Plus
shortDescription: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×.

description: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.
name: Poison Heal
shortDescription: This Pokemon is healed by 1/8 of its max HP each turn when poisoned; no HP loss.

description: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.
name: Poison Point
shortDescription: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

description: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Pecharunt and poisons or badly poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.
name: Poison Puppeteer
shortDescription: Pecharunt: If this Pokemon poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.

description: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.
longDescription: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.
name: Poison Touch
shortDescription: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning.

description: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Zygarde in its 10% or 50% Forme, it changes to Complete Forme when it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP at the end of the turn.
name: Power Construct
shortDescription: If Zygarde 10%/50%, changes to Complete if at 1/2 max HP or less at end of turn.

description: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their moves multiplied by 1.3. This affects Doom Desire and Future Sight, even if the user is not on the field.
name: Power Spot
shortDescription: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their moves multiplied by 1.3.

description: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
longDescription: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.
name: Power of Alchemy
shortDescription: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints.

description: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.
name: Prankster
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Status moves have priority raised by 1, but Dark types are immune.

description: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.
name: Pressure
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is the target of a foe's move, that move loses one additional PP.

description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.
longDescription: On switch-in, the weather becomes Heavy Rain, which includes all the effects of Rain and prevents damaging Fire-type moves from executing. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Delta Stream or Desolate Land Abilities.
name: Primordial Sea
shortDescription: On switch-in, heavy rain begins until this Ability is not active in battle.

description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
name: Prism Armor
shortDescription: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
name: Propeller Tail
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

description: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
longDescription: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.
name: Protean
shortDescription: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
longDescription: If Sun is active or this Pokemon uses a held Booster Energy, this Pokemon's highest stat is multiplied by 1.3, or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Sun, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Sun is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when this Pokemon is no longer active.
name: Protosynthesis
shortDescription: Sun active or Booster Energy used: highest stat is 1.3×, or 1.5× if Speed.

description: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
name: Psychic Surge
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.

description: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.
name: Punk Rock
shortDescription: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from sound moves. Its own have 1.3× power.

description: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.
name: Pure Power
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.

description: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.
name: Purifying Salt
shortDescription: Ghost damage to this Pokemon dealt with a halved offensive stat; can't be statused.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
longDescription: If Electric Terrain is active or this Pokemon uses a held Booster Energy, this Pokemon's highest stat is multiplied by 1.3, or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Electric Terrain, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Electric Terrain is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when this Pokemon is no longer active.
name: Quark Drive
shortDescription: Electric Terrain active or Booster Energy used: highest stat is 1.3×, or 1.5× if Speed.

description: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
longDescription: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
name: Queenly Majesty
shortDescription: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.

description: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
name: Quick Draw
shortDescription: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.

description: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.
longDescription: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Speed is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon ignores the paralysis effect of halving Speed.
name: Quick Feet
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is statused, its Speed is 1.5×; ignores Speed drop from paralysis.

description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.
name: RKS System
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is a Silvally, its type changes to match its held Memory.

description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.
longDescription: If Rain is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
name: Rain Dish
shortDescription: If Rain is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.

description: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or if an opposing Pokemon affected this Pokemon with the Intimidate Ability.
name: Rattled
shortDescription: Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or Intimidated.

description: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
longDescription: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.
name: Receiver
shortDescription: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints.

description: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.
longDescription: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have their power multiplied by 1.2. Does not affect Struggle.
name: Reckless
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have 1.2× power; not Struggle.

description: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
name: Refrigerate
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice type and have 1.2× power.

description: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.
name: Regenerator
shortDescription: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.

description: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
longDescription: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled. Berries that restore HP or PP have the amount doubled, Berries that raise stat stages have the amount doubled, Berries that halve damage taken quarter it instead, and a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry has the attacker lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
name: Ripen
shortDescription: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled.

description: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.
longDescription: This Pokemon's attacks have their power multiplied by 1.25 against targets of the same gender or multiplied by 0.75 against targets of the opposite gender. There is no modifier if either this Pokemon or the target is genderless.
name: Rivalry
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks do 1.25× on same gender targets; 0.75× on opposite gender.

description: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
longDescription: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage, except Struggle. Does not affect Life Orb damage or crash damage.
name: Rock Head
shortDescription: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage besides Struggle/Life Orb/crash damage.

description: Powers up Rock-type moves.
name: Rocky Payload
shortDescription: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Rock-type attack.

description: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.
longDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.
name: Rough Skin
shortDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.

description: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.
name: Run Away
shortDescription: No competitive use.

description: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.
longDescription: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
name: Sand Force
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Ground/Rock/Steel attacks do 1.3× in Sandstorm; immunity to it.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.
longDescription: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
name: Sand Rush
shortDescription: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled; immunity to Sandstorm.

description: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.
name: Sand Spit
shortDescription: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins.

description: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.
name: Sand Stream
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.
longDescription: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
name: Sand Veil
shortDescription: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25×; immunity to Sandstorm.

description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move.
name: Sap Sipper
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised 1 stage if hit by a Grass move; Grass immunity.

description: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.
longDescription: On switch-in, if this Pokemon is a Wishiwashi that is level 20 or above and has more than 1/4 of its maximum HP left, it changes to School Form. If it is in School Form and its HP drops to 1/4 of its maximum HP or less, it changes to Solo Form at the end of the turn. If it is in Solo Form and its HP is greater than 1/4 its maximum HP at the end of the turn, it changes to School Form.
name: Schooling
shortDescription: If user is Wishiwashi, changes to School Form if it has > 1/4 max HP, else Solo Form.

description: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.
longDescription: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
name: Scrappy
shortDescription: Fighting, Normal moves hit Ghost. Immune to Intimidate.

description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
name: Screen Cleaner
shortDescription: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.

description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
name: Seed Sower
shortDescription: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.

description: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon's moves have their secondary effect chance doubled. This effect stacks with the Rainbow effect, except for secondary effects that cause the target to flinch.
name: Serene Grace
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves have their secondary effect chance doubled.

description: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
name: Shadow Shield
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

description: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.
longDescription: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell, are a Ghost type, or also have this Ability.
name: Shadow Tag
shortDescription: Prevents foes from choosing to switch unless they also have this Ability.

description: Powers up slicing moves.
name: Sharpness
shortDescription: This Pokemon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.

description: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.
longDescription: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.
name: Shed Skin
shortDescription: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its status cured at the end of each turn.

description: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.
longDescription: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have their power multiplied by 1.3, but the secondary effects are removed. If a secondary effect was removed, it also removes the user's Life Orb recoil and Shell Bell recovery, and prevents the target's Anger Shell, Berserk, Color Change, Emergency Exit, Pickpocket, Wimp Out, Red Card, Eject Button, Kee Berry, and Maranga Berry from activating.
name: Sheer Force
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have 1.3× power; nullifies the effects.

description: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
name: Shell Armor
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

description: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack. Attacks with secondary effects that are prevented include those with a chance (even 100%) to paralyze, sleep, freeze, burn, poison, confuse, cause this Pokemon to flinch, cause this Pokemon's stat stages to be lowered, as well as Anchor Shot, Eerie Spell, Fling, Psychic Noise, Salt Cure, Spirit Shackle, Syrup Bomb, and Throat Chop. The effect of Sparkling Aria is prevented if this Pokemon is the only target. Secondary effects added by King's Rock, Razor Fang, and the Poison Touch, Stench, and Toxic Chain Abilities are also prevented against this Pokemon.
name: Shield Dust
shortDescription: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack.

description: When its HP drops to half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Minior, it changes to its Core forme if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, and changes to Meteor Form if it has more than 1/2 its maximum HP. This check is done on switch-in and at the end of each turn. While in its Meteor Form, it cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn.
name: Shields Down
