shortDescription: If Minior, switch-in/end of turn it changes to Core at 1/2 max HP or less, else Meteor.

description: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon's stat changes.
name: Simple
shortDescription: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages is raised or lowered, the amount is doubled.

description: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.
longDescription: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times. Triple Kick and Triple Axel do not check accuracy for the second and third hits.
name: Skill Link
shortDescription: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times.

description: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.
name: Slow Start
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack and Speed are halved for 5 turns.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.
name: Slush Rush
shortDescription: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

description: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.
name: Sniper
shortDescription: If this Pokemon strikes with a critical hit, the damage is multiplied by 1.5.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.
longDescription: If Snow is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8.
name: Snow Cloak
shortDescription: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25×.

description: The Pokémon makes it snow when it enters a battle.
name: Snow Warning
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.

description: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.
longDescription: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and it loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. These effects are prevented if the Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
name: Solar Power
shortDescription: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×; loses 1/8 max HP per turn.

description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.
name: Solid Rock
shortDescription: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat every time another Pokémon faints.
name: Soul-Heart
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage when another Pokemon faints.

description: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.
name: Soundproof
shortDescription: This Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves, unless it used the move.

description: The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage at the end of each full turn it has been on the field.
name: Speed Boost
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage at the end of each full turn on the field.

description: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.
name: Stakeout
shortDescription: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled against a target that switched in this turn.

description: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.
name: Stall
shortDescription: This Pokemon moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.

description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
name: Stalwart
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

description: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
name: Stamina
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.

description: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is an Aegislash, it changes to Blade Forme before using an attacking move, and changes to Shield Forme before using King's Shield.
name: Stance Change
shortDescription: If Aegislash, changes Forme to Blade before attacks and Shield before King's Shield.

description: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.
name: Static
shortDescription: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.

description: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.
name: Steadfast
shortDescription: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.

description: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by a Fire- or Water-type move.
name: Steam Engine
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by Fire/Water moves.

description: Powers up Steel-type moves.
name: Steelworker
shortDescription: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Steel-type attack.

description: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
longDescription: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. This affects Doom Desire even if the user is not on the field.
name: Steely Spirit
shortDescription: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.

description: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.
longDescription: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Stench
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to flinch gain a 10% chance to flinch.

description: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.
longDescription: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack, unless the attack knocks out this Pokemon. A Sticky Barb will be transferred to other Pokemon regardless of this Ability.
name: Sticky Hold
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack.

description: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Water-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Water-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.
name: Storm Drain
shortDescription: This Pokemon draws Water moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Water immunity.

description: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon's bite-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.5.
name: Strong Jaw
shortDescription: This Pokemon's bite-based attacks have 1.5× power. Bug Bite is not boosted.

description: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. OHKO moves fail when used against this Pokemon.
name: Sturdy
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. Immune to OHKO.

description: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.
name: Suction Cups
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.

description: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.
name: Super Luck
shortDescription: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.

description: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle
name: Supersweet Syrup
shortDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.

description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
longDescription: This Pokemon's moves have their power multiplied by 1+(X × 0.1), where X is the total number of times any Pokemon has fainted on the user's side when this Ability became active, and X cannot be greater than 5.
name: Supreme Overlord
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.

description: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
name: Surge Surfer
shortDescription: If Electric Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

description: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
longDescription: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Bug-type attack.
name: Swarm
shortDescription: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5× with Bug attacks.

description: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.
longDescription: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep, but those already asleep do not wake up immediately. This Pokemon and its allies cannot use Rest successfully or become affected by Yawn, and those previously affected will not fall asleep.
name: Sweet Veil
shortDescription: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep; those already asleep do not wake up.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.
longDescription: If Rain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
name: Swift Swim
shortDescription: If Rain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
name: Sword of Ruin
shortDescription: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Defense multiplied by 0.75.

description: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.
longDescription: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately. Does not activate if the ally's item was stolen or knocked off, or if the ally used an Eject Button or Eject Pack.
name: Symbiosis
shortDescription: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately.

description: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.
longDescription: If another Pokemon burns, paralyzes, poisons, or badly poisons this Pokemon, that Pokemon receives the same non-volatile status condition.
name: Synchronize
shortDescription: If another Pokemon burns/poisons/paralyzes this Pokemon, it also gets that status.

description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
name: Tablets of Ruin
shortDescription: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.
name: Tangled Feet
shortDescription: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.

description: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
name: Tangling Hair
shortDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.

description: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.
longDescription: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have their power multiplied by 1.5, including Struggle. This effect comes after a move's effect changes its own power.
name: Technician
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have 1.5× power, including Struggle.

description: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.
name: Telepathy
shortDescription: This Pokemon does not take damage from attacks made by its allies.

description: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Terapagos at full HP, the effectiveness of attacks against it is changed to 0.5 unless this Pokemon is immune to the move. Multi-hit moves retain the same effectiveness throughout the attack.
name: Tera Shell
shortDescription: Terapagos: If full HP, attacks taken have 0.5× effectiveness unless naturally immune.

description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
name: Tera Shift
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is a Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.

description: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
name: Teraform Zero
shortDescription: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.

description: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
longDescription: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.
name: Teravolt
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
longDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised 1 stage after it is damaged by a Fire-type move. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
name: Thermal Exchange
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 when damaged by Fire moves; can't be burned.

description: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
longDescription: If a Pokemon uses a Fire- or Ice-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.
name: Thick Fat
shortDescription: Fire-/Ice-type moves against this Pokemon deal damage with a halved offensive stat.

description: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.
name: Tinted Lens
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks that are not very effective on a target deal double damage.

description: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
longDescription: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
name: Torrent
shortDescription: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5× with Water attacks.

description: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
name: Tough Claws
shortDescription: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.

description: Powers up physical moves when the Pokémon is poisoned.
longDescription: While this Pokemon is poisoned, the power of its physical attacks is multiplied by 1.5.
name: Toxic Boost
shortDescription: While this Pokemon is poisoned, its physical attacks have 1.5× power.

description: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move
longDescription: This Pokemon's attacks have a 30% chance of badly poisoning. This effect comes before a move's inherent secondary effect chance.
name: Toxic Chain
shortDescription: This Pokemon's attacks have a 30% chance of badly poisoning.

description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
name: Toxic Debris
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.

description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.
longDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies a random opposing Pokemon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokemon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.
name: Trace
shortDescription: On switch-in, or when it can, this Pokemon copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.

description: Powers up Electric-type moves.
name: Transistor
shortDescription: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 while using an Electric-type attack.

description: Gives priority to the Pokémon's healing moves.
name: Triage
shortDescription: This Pokemon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

description: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.
name: Truant
shortDescription: This Pokemon skips every other turn instead of using a move.

description: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
longDescription: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.
name: Turboblaze
shortDescription: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

description: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.
longDescription: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's Attack, Special Attack, and accuracy stat stages when taking damage, and ignores other Pokemon's Defense, Special Defense, and evasiveness stat stages when dealing damage.
name: Unaware
shortDescription: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's stat stages when taking or doing damage.

description: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.
longDescription: If this Pokemon loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.
name: Unburden
shortDescription: Speed is doubled on held item loss; boost is lost if it switches, gets new item/Ability.

description: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.
longDescription: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.
name: Unnerve
shortDescription: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries.

description: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.
name: Unseen Fist
shortDescription: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.

description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
name: Vessel of Ruin
shortDescription: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.

description: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.
name: Victory Star
shortDescription: This Pokemon and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.

description: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
name: Vital Spirit
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

description: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.
name: Volt Absorb
shortDescription: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Electric moves; Electric immunity.

description: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
longDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one. Does not affect Pokemon with the Abilities As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
name: Wandering Spirit
shortDescription: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one.

description: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.
name: Water Absorb
shortDescription: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Water moves; Water immunity.

description: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.
longDescription: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled while using a Water-type attack. If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
name: Water Bubble
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Water power is 2×; it can't be burned; Fire power against it is halved.

description: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.
name: Water Compaction
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages after it is damaged by a Water-type move.

description: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.
name: Water Veil
shortDescription: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

description: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.
longDescription: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage and its Speed is raised by 2 stages.
name: Weak Armor
shortDescription: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, Defense is lowered by 1, Speed is raised by 2.

description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves and raises its Defense by 2 stages when hit by a Fire-type move.
name: Well-Baked Body
shortDescription: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages if hit by a Fire move; Fire immunity.

description: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
name: White Smoke
shortDescription: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

description: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
longDescription: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.
name: Wimp Out
shortDescription: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.

description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
longDescription: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from a wind move or when Tailwind begins on this Pokemon's side.
name: Wind Power
shortDescription: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins.

description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
longDescription: This Pokemon is immune to wind moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a wind move or when Tailwind begins on this Pokemon's side.
name: Wind Rider
shortDescription: Attack raised by 1 if hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins. Wind move immunity.

description: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.
name: Wonder Guard
shortDescription: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.

description: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.
longDescription: Non-damaging moves that check accuracy have their accuracy changed to 50% when used against this Pokemon. This effect comes before other effects that modify accuracy.
name: Wonder Skin
shortDescription: Status moves with accuracy checks are 50% accurate when used on this Pokemon.

description: Changes the Pokémon’s shape when HP is half or less.
longDescription: If this Pokemon is a Darmanitan or Galarian Darmanitan, it changes to Zen Mode if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP at the end of a turn. If Darmanitan's HP is above 1/2 of its maximum HP at the end of a turn, it changes back to Standard Mode.
name: Zen Mode
shortDescription: If Darmanitan, at end of turn changes Mode to Standard if > 1/2 max HP, else Zen.

description: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
name: Zero to Hero
shortDescription: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
